designationHistory.indexText: Cape Meares National Wildlife Refuge, established in 1938, boasts views of nearby rocky islands, vertical coastal cliffs, and rolling headlands topped with old-growth forest dominated by Sitka Spruce and Western Hemlock.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year.
